entries.title: What's new
entries.summary: A page per product that lists what was released, by date, module, user or product, with filters and a link to how to use each one.
entries.detail: Inside a product, What's new shows only that product. From the main page, choose All products or one product. Use View by to group the list and Filter to narrow it. Select More for a short longer text and How to use for the guide page.

entries.title: Guide me
entries.summary: Each product page has a Guide me button that opens the user chooser, with Everyone first.
entries.detail: The product page hero also has the search box and a What's new button, and floating labels use icons that fit the product.

entries.title: User journeys
entries.summary: Readers pick the kind of user they are and follow the guides they need, in order.
entries.detail: Nothing is hidden: Everyone still shows the whole guide. Journeys are written from the app's own user types.

entries.title: Smarter update checks
entries.summary: A check compares each page with everything that changed after its own last update, and keeps findings nobody applied yet.

entries.title: Admin locked during setup
entries.summary: Setup now locks the admin behind Cloudflare Access for you.
